scope: Optional recovery of classes 1,2,4,7 only. Existing v1 candidates and teacher contracts preserved.
weight_selection: Minimum pair BCE on reused validation split across 60 fixed epochs; no test tuning.

release_checks.reused_test: Class precision >= .97 for each enabled class; global runtime precision and recall must not decrease.
release_checks.independent_60_cad: Each enabled covered class precision >= .97; total exact recall greater than no-merge at the same validation display thresholds; old candidates unchanged.

test_caveat: Source test already used in earlier routing evaluation; now a regression test, not a new unseen test. Independent 60 CAD generated before affinity weight training/evaluation. Circular-through-slot not covered by that independent generator.
